package server

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

// Product code: env-path-delete is out of scope, go clean of a cache is not.
func cleanup(runID string) {
	_ = os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "dagu", runID))
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-modcache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
}
